purpose: Portable OZM skill-package manifest for distribution mode, optional dependencies, permissions, provenance, and script integrity.

ozmOnly.description: Only ozone-manager plus active ozm-* child skills are packaged.

fullSkillShelf.description: OZM runs inside a larger local skill shelf with preserved specialists and other non-OZM skills.

internalOperatorLocal.description: Maintained local skill shelf; archive may retain operator-local history when marked historical-only.

publicRedacted.operatorLocalPathPolicy: replace with <skills-root>, <codex-home>, <resolved-python>, <project-root>, <rfmc-root>, or archive historical marker
publicRedacted.archivePolicy: archive local paths must be historical-only and are not normal runtime instructions

pathVariables.<skills-root>: Active Codex skills root containing ozone-manager and ozm-* child skills.
pathVariables.<resolved-python>: Operator-local Python interpreter resolved by the environment entrypoint or install process.
pathVariables.<project-root>: The governed repository or task workspace root.
pathVariables.<rfmc-root>: Optional operator-local reusable feature/module/component catalog root, configured outside the portable OZM package.
pathVariables.<skills-archive>: Operator-local archive root for restored donor skills; not part of portable OZM runtime.

ui-ux-pro-max:data-backend.reason: Large local UI/UX search dataset backend; OZM routes load ozm-ux-ui-expert-suite first and lower the ceiling if this backend is absent.

repo-knowledge-graph:graph-backend.reason: Archived repo graph specialist backend. OZM routes to ozm-repo-graph-reconstruction first; restore this donor only for explicit standalone archaeology or backend-parity investigation.

repo-analysis-deep-reconstruction:recons.reason: Archived deep reconstruction specialist backend. OZM owns bundle schema, source anchors, mechanism fidelity, and claim ceiling; restore this donor only for explicit standalone archaeology.

capability-evolver:evolution-backend.reason: Archived capability-evolution backend. OZM owns candidate lifecycle, eval, rollback, promotion, API posture, and claim ceiling; restore only for explicit donor archaeology.

EvoAgentX:evolution-framework.reason: Optional framework donor for workflow evolution concepts. OZM normal routing uses ozm-capability-evolution-governance and does not depend on the framework package.

user-authorized OZM skill files during hardening
permissions.script_posture: Local deterministic maintenance scripts. They are not a remote execution sandbox and must run with operator approval/context.

trustedProvenance.review_posture: Internal maintained skill package; third-party redistribution must rerun script hash and optional dependency checks.
